name: LLaMA-Factory
summary: Apache-2.0 toolkit to fine-tune 100+ LLMs and VLMs via zero-code CLI and the LLaMA Board Gradio web UI.
description: Established project (hiyouga/LlamaFactory; ACL 2024; not archived; not a 2026 launch). PyPI package llamafactory 0.9.5 verified 2026-11-10. Docs at https://llamafactory.readthedocs.io/en/latest/. Apache-2.0 (LICENSE). Model weights, GPUs and any third-party hosting are separate from the open-source toolkit.

agent_access.notes: pip install llamafactory or source/Docker install per docs. Model and GPU resources are separate.
